name: Leo
source:
Date of Death: August 17
Likes: Surt, the fire wolf
Dislikes: Snow

The passionate King of the blazing land.
He gets in a fight all the time with King Jean, but they are good friends. He has come to the land of the dead to look for a bride, but who knows wat will happen...?
